title: advanced-reboot tests failed due to the significant number of BGP routes
author: msosyak
body:

**Description**
After changes in the testbed routing https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/ansible/doc/README.testbed.Routing.md routes, that ware statically configured on vEOS VM's, now are announced by ExaBGP from ptf container. That significantly increased the time need to check peer state, especially to receive and parse `show ip/ipv6 route bgp | json` command, as now all 6400 routes are received by BGP. And caused advanced-reboot tests fails with error `FAILED:dut:SSH threads haven\'t finished for 300 seconds`.

So before changes in testbed routing one iteration of this loop https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/ansible/roles/test/files/ptftests/arista.py#L114 takes less than 0.2 sec, now it takes around of 45 sec.  As a result, the state is not updated frequently enough, the queue with commands to update the state or quit grows, and in the end, quit command was not consumed during a timeout here https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/3d2f4909e978f6a5785bd9a2f7861a88b83f8569/ansible/roles/test/files/ptftests/advanced-reboot.py#L860
<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run Fast-reboot test on the latest sonic-mgmt 

**Describe the results you received:**
Tests failed with error `FAILED:dut:SSH threads haven\'t finished for 300 seconds`.

**Describe the results you expected:**
Test passed

**Additional information you deem important:**
The output of `show ipv6 route bgp` before test: 
- on the setup with old routing configuration:
```
ARISTA04T1>show ipv6 route bgp
Displaying 0 of 6404 IPv6 routing table entries
Codes: C - connected, S - static, K - kernel, O - OSPF, B - BGP, R - RIP, A B - BGP Aggregate, A O - OSPF Summary, I L1 - ISIS level 1, I L2 - ISIS level 2, NG - Nexthop Group Static Route

ARISTA04T1>
```
- on the setup with new routing configuration:
```
Displaying 6400 of 6410 IPv6 routing table entries
Codes: C - connected, S - static, K - kernel, O - OSPF, B - BGP, R - RIP, A B - BGP Aggregate, A O - OSPF Summary, I L1 - ISI
S level 1, I L2 - ISIS level 2, NG - Nexthop Group Static Route

 B    20c0:a808::/64 [200/0]
       via fc0a::ff, Ethernet5
 B    20c0:a808:0:80::/64 [200/0]
       via fc0a::ff, Ethernet5
 B    20c0:a810::/64 [200/0]
       via fc0a::ff, Ethernet5
  * * *
```

comments.author: msosyak
comments.body:
To resolve this issue I guess the right way is to check only routes from the appropriate subnet instead of all BGP routes.  I think we can calculate the expected subnet at the test setup.

@lguohan  @stepanblyschak  Please have a look

comments.author: msosyak
comments.body: With these https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/pull/1661 changes I was able to pass the fast-reboot test

Summary:
After changes in routing configuration for topology arista module takes to much time to check BGP state, so refactored logic to check the best route match instead of checking all BGP routes.
Fixes # (#1655)

### Type of change

<!--

- [x] Bug fix

- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Approach
#### How did you do it?
- refactored BGP state check to dump the best match instead of parsing all BGP routes
- refactored advanced reboot test to avoid queue growing
#### How did you verify/test it?
Pass fast-reboot test
